# Image slots

**Real photos:** do not edit code. Follow `assets/photos/README.md` (drop the file in `assets/photos/` and add it to `manifest.json`).

Every image in the site is an illustrated **placeholder** drawn for Navyug Learn. To use real photography, export a file with the **same name and aspect ratio** and put it in this folder. If you switch format (for example `.jpg`), also update the extension where the filename appears: `js/catalogue.js`, `js/pages.js`, and the HTML files.

Course covers are shown at 5:3 and cropped with `object-fit: cover`, so keep the subject away from the edges. Hero images are cropped to fit a tall panel.
